channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Iman Shumpert | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Iman Shumpert from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Nash on Iman Shumpert
item.description:
Steve Nash on Iman Shumpert:

“I think it’s great to have his personality. He gives our group some juice, energy, and life, which is important. I think he has a reputation of playing extremely hard, defending and doing the dirty work.”

Steve Nash on Iman Shumpert, Jan 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: James Johnson on Iman Shumpert
item.description:
Johnson received four stitches and Shumpert will get some work done on those chipped teeth, though he is not expected to miss any time.

“I just made a move and I think Shumpert's face got in the way and I elbowed him,”

James Johnson on Iman Shumpert, Mar 5, 2017. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: David Griffin on JR Smith, Iman Shumpert
item.description:
Howard Beck:David Griffin:

“We got Iman Shumpert without giving up a first-round pick, because we were willing to take on JR Smith.”

David Griffin on JR Smith, Iman Shumpert, Mar 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @HowardBeck.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James, Iman Shumpert
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Carmelo on Shumpert and JR not playing tonight:

“I would love to play against my brothers. It seems like LeBron took all my family from me.”

Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James, Iman Shumpert, Nov 4, 2015. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: David Griffin on Iman Shumpert
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:David Griffin on Iman Shumpert:

“In training last week he had an issue where he hit the rim with his R wrist ... I believe catching a lob”

David Griffin on Iman Shumpert, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: LeBron James on Iman Shumpert
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:LeBron on Iman Shumpert:

“Like I told you guys yesterday, injuries are probably the only thing that can stop us longterm.”

LeBron James on Iman Shumpert, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: David Blatt on Iman Shumpert
item.description:
Chris Fedor:#Cavs David Blatt on Iman Shumpert's restriction:

“We are still a few weeks away from seeing him go all out for a full game”

David Blatt on Iman Shumpert, Jan 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Iman Shumpert
item.description:
Chris Herring:Woodson, on Shumpert's knee injury:

“Don't know. We're gonna fly him back to New York and have him evaluated.”

Mike Woodson on Iman Shumpert, Feb 19, 2014. Source: Twitter @HerringWSJ.
